body:
These are the same control - wiping memory. Both 6.5.2 and 8.3.7 have the wrong CWE. 

6.5.2 is about sensitive data at rest
8.3.7 is about data protection, which can mean on disk or more generally.

Therefore, I believe we delete 6.5.2, leaving 8.3.7 in place. Please change the CWE to CWE-226 “Sensitive Information Uncleared Before Release”
title: 6.5.2 and 8.3.7 are the same. Which is to go?
